title: Parallel Logic Expert with Operator Routing
tools: AI Reasoning (Mixture of Experts, Fuzzy Logic) · Machine Learning (PyTorch)
blurb: Mixture-of-experts transformer with fuzzy-logic operator routing of token representations. Pre-registered finding: parallel branch improves performance by 1.4 points, but the logic operators do not outperform a matched control.
long: I built a mixture-of-experts transformer that routes token representations through specialized logical operators (differentiable AND, OR and NOT), with cross-attention between the main model and those reasoning paths, as well as the PyTorch training and evaluation pipeline.

I pre-registered the eval and ran it three seeds. The parallel branch + fusion head outperforms the linear-head baseline by 1.4 percentage points across all three seeds. However, the parameter-matched control without logic operators performs equally well on ProofWriter and MNLI (Multi-Genre Natural Language Inference), so the improvement is due to increased capacity rather than the presence of logical operators.
The routing diagnostics reveal which operators the router actually uses at each depth. The project page has the full paper and an interactive playground.
highlights: +1.4 pp over the linear head in all 3 seeds
Logic operators = parameter-matched control (an honest null)
